name: next_monitor
purpose: Next run: close the open monitor items that need a measurement, not a guess. Water flicker bisect (#80), sky and tree fog (#81), water fog multiplier (#82, values for a person to judge), GI and LOD cost (#83), portal emitter (#84), and the overlay in a level (#79). Each variant has a check that decides it.
